rowText: (W16) While away from slot A: A's dot is a hollow cyan ring; if A is the visible ghost neighbour, a cyan spark sits at that row edge, outside the ghost's fade.

steps.press: read the chat-slot dot for slot A, and the ghost-prev element (A's title preview), while B was active and A was mid-generation
steps.expected: A's dot is a hollow cyan ring, or a cyan spark at the ghost's row edge
steps.landing: A's dot computed style: border rgb(150,150,150), background rgba(143,168,196,0.3) -- identical to every untouched, idle dot; the ghost-prev span for A carried no distinct class or spark, just the plain ghost styling

verdictSentence: While slot A was generating in the background and B was on screen, A's dot and its ghost preview looked exactly like every other idle chat -- no hollow cyan ring, no cyan spark. A person watching the strip would have no way to tell that slot A was still working.
